correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact graph, duality, tight-edge graph rank, bipartite parity propagation and exhaustive two-height potential classification. Each sign assignment is feasible and has all edges tight; the disjoint lower/upper cases count exactly every normalized dual vertex. For n≥4 the degree classes identify Aut(H_n)=S_n, and sign reversal complements/permutes within-class graph types, giving the orbit Burnside formula. An explicit tail split proves the asymptotic. Standalone exact verification independently recovered facet totals for n=2,...,6 and orbit totals for n=4,5; finite checks are not used as the infinite-family proof.

value.rationale: The family is the canonical edge-incidence subdivision of complete graphs, so its real transportation norms are naturally motivated. The result gives an evaluated all-n facet count and a complete S_n × sign orbit dictionary in terms of unlabeled graph complementation, with an even-order fixed-point phenomenon. The asymptotic shows a rigorous concentration of almost every facet on constant original-vertex height. These are structural facial invariants of an infinite family and not a routine numerical recomputation.
